disclaimer: Emulator-defined diagnostic against an intact reference. It runs the emulator's own package-unpacker rules on a flash image; it is not a boot gate and not a statement about a physical FM-1. An unpacker refusal is not proof that hardware is bricked, an accepted image is not proof that hardware boots, and no recovery path is modelled. hardwareBootability is always unknown.
note: Curated boot-area scenarios (Component 7, Stage 7C): emulator-defined diagnostics under named inputs. hardwareBootability is unknown and the recovery assessment is recovery-unknown in every row. Interrupted-cycle outcomes are synthetic inputs. No firmware bytes are stored; the identities are SHA-256 digests.
